shared_elements: human figures in profile with long fringed/pleated robes
hand/arm holding a small object or vessel
low-relief frieze arranged in a horizontal register
patterned detailing on garments and hair/beard
band of repeated ornament beside the figural scene
justification: Both surfaces show shallow-relief profile figures in long, minutely patterned fringed robes whose extended hand grasps a small object, set beside a field of multi-petalled rosettes used as a repeating decorative filler — a fairly specific combination of drapery convention, rosette motif and offering gesture. The chief difference in content is that B is dominated by a large panel of dense repeated wedge-sign writing and shows only fragments of figures, whereas A shows a continuous ordered procession of five bowl-bearing attendants with a leading figure clasping hands, with no inscription.
